name: Samukawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Samukawa town emblem in red: a ring of concentric arcs crossed by a diagonal stroke with an arrowhead.
history: Municipal flag of Samukawa, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 October 1950.

features.role: Samukawa town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs crossed by a diagonal stroke with an arrowhead
